title: Constructible sheaves reduce to finite pushforwards
statement:
Let $U$ be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] and $C$ a constructible abelian sheaf on $U_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-constructible-abelian-sheaf], an object of $\Ab(U_{\Et})$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] (the blueprint's 'constructible torsion' sheaf: such a sheaf has finite geometric stalks and is killed by a positive integer, Step 1). Then there are an integer $m\ge0$ and, for $i=1,\dots,m$, a morphism of schemes $h_i:V_i\to U$ which is finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] and of finite presentation (locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]) and a finite abelian group $M_i$, and a monomorphism of abelian sheaves

$$
 C\hookrightarrow\bigoplus_{i=1}^m(h_i)_*\underline{M_i}
$$

in $\Ab(U_{\Et})$, into the finite direct sum (biproduct [def-weil-additive-category]) of the direct images [def-weil-pbc-direct-image] of the constant abelian sheaves $\underline{M_i}$ on $(V_i)_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. (Stacks 09Z7 (2). The $\Lambda$-module form 09Z7 (3) is [lem-weil-pbc-constructible-module-finite-pushforward-embedding].)

proof.text: *A bound for the torsion.* $U$ is quasi-compact, so by [lem-weil-pbc-constructible-abelian-bounded-exponent] there is an integer $n\ge1$ with $n\cdot\mathrm{id}_C=0$. (Stacks does not state this step: it passes from (2) to (3) of 09Z7 by 'similarly'; with it the abelian statement becomes an instance of the module statement over the finite, hence Noetherian, ring $\mathbf Z/n$.)

*$C$ as a constructible sheaf of $\mathbf Z/n$-modules.* By [lem-weil-pbc-sheaves-killed-by-n-zmod-modules] (2) $C$ carries exactly one structure of sheaf of $(\mathbf Z/n)_U$-modules extending its abelian structure; call the resulting object $\tilde C\in\Mod(U_{\Et},\mathbf Z/n)$, so that $\mathrm{forget}(\tilde C)=C$. By [lem-weil-pbc-constructible-abelian-zn-module-constructible] $\tilde C$ is a constructible sheaf of $\mathbf Z/n$-modules in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf], with $\Lambda=\mathbf Z/n$ a finite commutative ring.

*The embedding over $\mathbf Z/n$ (Stacks' proof of 09Z7).* Apply [lem-weil-pbc-constructible-module-finite-pushforward-embedding] to the quasi-compact quasi-separated $U$, the finite ring $\Lambda=\mathbf Z/n$ and $\tilde C$: there are $m\ge0$, morphisms $h_i:V_i\to U$ ($i=1,\dots,m$) which are finite and locally of finite presentation, finite $\mathbf Z/n$-modules $M_i$ and a monomorphism $\tilde\iota:\tilde C\hookrightarrow\bigoplus_{i=1}^m(h_i)_*\underline{M_i}^{\mathbf Z/n}$ in $\Mod(U_{\Et},\mathbf Z/n)$, where $\underline{M_i}^{\mathbf Z/n}$ is the constant sheaf of $\mathbf Z/n$-modules on $(V_i)_{\Et}$. That node carries exactly the four steps of Stacks' proof of 09Z7, which are the same for (2) and (3): absolute Noetherian approximation $U=\lim U_t$ with $U_t$ of finite type over $\mathbf Z$ and affine transition maps (01ZA) and descent of the constructible sheaf to some $U_t$ (09YU), through [lem-weil-pbc-constructible-module-noetherian-descent]; the Noetherian case 09Z6 on $U_t$, through [lem-weil-pbc-constructible-module-finite-pushforward-noetherian]; finite over Noetherian is of finite presentation; and the pullback of the embedding to $U$ by exactness of pullback and finite base change 0959, through the closed node [lem-weil-pbc-finite-pushforward-embedding-pullback].

proof.text: *Forgetting the $\mathbf Z/n$-structure.* Let $\mathrm{forget}:\Mod(U_{\Et},\mathbf Z/n)\to\Ab(U_{\Et})$ be the forgetful functor. By [lem-weil-pbc-module-sheaves-colimits-forgetful] (1) it is exact, so it preserves kernels and $\mathrm{forget}(\tilde\iota)$ is a monomorphism; by (3) it preserves finite limits and colimits, hence (being additive) finite biproducts: $\mathrm{forget}\bigl(\bigoplus_i(h_i)_*\underline{M_i}^{\mathbf Z/n}\bigr)=\bigoplus_i\mathrm{forget}\bigl((h_i)_*\underline{M_i}^{\mathbf Z/n}\bigr)$ [def-weil-additive-category]. The direct image of a sheaf of $\mathbf Z/n$-modules is given on sections by the same formula $W\mapsto(\cdot)(W\times_UV_i)$ as the abelian direct image [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], so $\mathrm{forget}\circ(h_i)_*=(h_i)_*\circ\mathrm{forget}$; and $\mathrm{forget}(\underline{M_i}^{\mathbf Z/n})=\underline{M_i}$, the constant abelian sheaf on the underlying abelian group of $M_i$, both being the sheafification of the same presheaf $W\mapsto M_i$ of abelian groups ([def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]; the sheafification of a presheaf of modules has the abelian sheafification as underlying sheaf, [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification]). Each $M_i$, a finite $\mathbf Z/n$-module, is a finite abelian group. Since $\mathrm{forget}(\tilde C)=C$ (Step 2), $\iota=\mathrm{forget}(\tilde\iota):C\hookrightarrow\bigoplus_{i=1}^m(h_i)_*\underline{M_i}$ is a monomorphism in $\Ab(U_{\Et})$.

*The $h_i$ are of finite presentation.* Each $h_i$ is finite, hence affine [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], hence quasi-compact and separated, in particular quasi-separated; with 'locally of finite presentation' from Step 3 it is of finite presentation in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. (Mathlib: `AlgebraicGeometry.IsFinite` extends `IsAffineHom`, which gives `QuasiCompact` (Morphisms/Affine.lean:58); `IsFinite f ↔ IsProper f ∧ IsAffineHom f` (Morphisms/Proper.lean:99) gives separatedness.) This is the form asserted, with $m$, $h_i$, $M_i$ and $\iota$ of Step 4.

blueprint_sketch.statement:
If $U$ is quasi-compact and quasi-separated, every constructible torsion
sheaf $C$ admits a monomorphism

$$
C\longrightarrow\bigoplus_{i=1}^r(h_i)_*\underline{M_i},
$$

where each $h_i:V_i\to U$ is finite and finitely presented and each $M_i$ is
a finite abelian group.
blueprint_sketch.proof:
Write $U=\varprojlim U_\lambda$ with affine transition maps and noetherian,
quasi-compact, quasi-separated $U_\lambda$. The finite stratification of
$C$, its finite stalk groups, all restriction maps, and their equalizer
relations descend to one stage $U_\lambda$. We prove the assertion there by
noetherian induction on a closed complement of a dense stratum. Choose a
dense open $j:V\hookrightarrow U_\lambda$ where $C_\lambda$ is finite
locally constant and a finite etale cover $e:W\to V$ trivializing it. Take
the integral closure of $U_\lambda$ in $e_*\mathcal O_W$ and discard
components disjoint from $V$; this gives a finite map $h:W'\to U_\lambda$
extending $e$. The adjunction unit is a monomorphism on $V$,

$$
C_\lambda|_V\hookrightarrow e_*\underline M
=(h_*\underline M)|_V,
$$

for a finite group $M$.

Let $Z=U_\lambda\setminus V$ with its reduced closed structure. By
induction, $C_\lambda|_Z$ embeds into a finite sum
$\bigoplus_b(h_b)_*\underline{M_b}$ with $h_b$ finite over $Z$; composing
with $Z\hookrightarrow U_\lambda$ keeps the maps finite. Map
$C_\lambda$ to

$$
h_*\underline M\oplus\bigoplus_b(h_b)_*\underline{M_b}
$$

by the dense-open unit in the first component and restriction to $Z$ in the
remaining components. At a geometric point of $V$ the first component is
injective, and at a geometric point of $Z$ the second block is injective, so
the combined map is monic. This is the localization induction, including
the boundary and overlap comparison. Pull the finite diagram and monomorphism
back to $U$. Etale inverse image is exact, and finite direct image commutes
with this pullback by the finite geometric-stalk product formula. This gives
the displayed monomorphism and expands Tag `09Z7`.
